subject: general
question: The Budget Division that prepares the Union Budget of India is a part of the Department of ______ under the Ministry of Finance.
solution:
The correct answer is the department of __Economic Affairs.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Department of Economic Affairs under the Ministry of Finance has been entrusted with the responsibility of preparation and presentation of the Union Budget to Parliament.
 
• It formulates and monitors the country's economic policies and programs having a bearing on domestic and international aspects of economic management.
 
 
• Headquarters - New Delhi
 
• Ministry - Ministry of Finance
 
• Finance Minister - Smt. Nirmala Sitharaman (As of July 2022)
 
 
 
• The Union Budget is also referred to as the Annual Financial Statement in Article 112 of the Constitution of India.
 
• It is the annual budget of the Republic of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM)

 
 
• ​​DIPAM is the nodal agency of the Union Finance Ministry mandated to advise the Union Government in the matters of financial restructuring of Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)
 
• It also advises the government on methods and policies for attracting investment through capital markets.
 
 
 
• Department of Financial Services
 
 
• ​​The Department of Financial Services (DFS) supervises several key programs, policies, initiatives, and reforms of the Government concerning the Banking Sector, the Insurance Sector, and the Pension Sector in India.
 
• Initiatives and reforms relating to Financial Inclusion, Social Security, and Insurance as a Risk Transfer mechanism are also monitored by this agency.
 
 
 
• Department of Revenue
 
 
• ​​The Department of Revenue functions under the overall direction and control of the Secretary (Revenue).
 
• It exercises control in respect of matters relating to all the Direct and Indirect Union Taxes.
 
• Such control is exercised through two statutory Boards namely:
 
 
• The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) - Monitoring laws governing Income Taxes.
 
• The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) - Monitoring laws such as Goods and Service Tax, Customs, etc.
